title: Helping Hands: Temporary TV Assistance Needed
summary: Temporary early-evening help is needed 4–5 times a week through October 18 to turn on a resident’s TV. Call or text Ted Silva at 508-965-6072.
public_detail:
Georgeanne’s Helping Hands is seeking a temporary volunteer to assist a resident living alone on Frangipani Circle with turning on and setting up their television.

The resident’s relative normally helps several times each week but will be away through October 18. A volunteer located near Frangipani may receive calls in the early evening, possibly 4–5 times per week, solely to help get the television on and running.

This temporary assistance would reduce the resident’s frustration and give their relative peace of mind.

To volunteer, call or text Ted Silva of Georgeanne’s Helping Hands at 508-965-6072.
